notes.title: Update 9
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone![/b]

We have made some additional fixes and improvements to the game, mostly stability and quality of life fixes. Here is the list of changes:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that happened when the movement controls were set to the arrow keys and this caused movement to abruptly halt for some strange reason. 
Now when this happens, you can just press any other key and everything will work as intended.
[*] We have added an additional startup option to the game: 
[b]Vulkan [/b]mode, which should fix some weird compatibility issues with mainly AMD video cards.
[*] Fine-tuned the controller dead zone setting.
[*] We fixed a strange crash that could happen when interacting with the football.
[*] Some materials were too dark and are now fixed.
[*] Some localization fixes.
[/list]

[u]We hope you have fun and please leave a review if you like the game :)[/u]
Crimsonite Team

notes.title: Update 7
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone![/b]

We are back with another update to the game, there have been a lot of small improvements over the past few months, which have all added up to this patch. So without further ado:

[b]The Japanese translations has been meticolously reworked[/b], which essentially means a complete overhaul of all the descriptions and story elements in the game.
[u]We really hope that our Japanese players will enjoy this qualitative leap![/u]

We have upgraded the engine version of the game to the latest Unreal Engine version, [b]which should bring some additional performance improvements.[/b]

We also recently added the option to launch the game in DirectX 11 mode, which should help older systems run the game better.

[b]We have made several small changes to the look and feel of the game:
[/b][list]
[*] Completely remade glass materials, with several different variations for furniture, windows or lamps.
[*] We have changed the amount and behaviour of fog on the island, you should be able to see better, and the overall "greyness" you could feel in the garden areas should be greatly reduced.
[*] Some wooden surfaces have been re-coloured or improved.
[*] In low light settings, you should see less fog colour overlay.
[*] We have disabled the player's default depth of field effect. This means that the blurriness you experienced when looking at distant objects without zooming is gone.
[/list]
We are steadily working towards the console releases of the game, first on Playstation and Xbox and hopefully on the Nintendo Switch 2 as well in the future. 

[b]Of course, for our Steam users, we will include any upgrades and features that we develop for these systems.[/b]

That's all for now.

[b]Please leave a review if you liked the game! :)
[/b]
[b]Have a wonderful day[/b]
Crimsonite Team

notes.title: Update 6
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We have made some minor improvements to the game, taking your feedback into account.
Here is the list of changes:

[list]
[*] Loading in the game is now handled differently, resulting in much less RAM usage. This makes it possible to run the game with less RAM, and also reduces loading times.
[*] Every faucet in the mansion can now fill the pot with water, even the bathtubs!
[*] Checkpoint location shenanigans have also been fixed. You will no longer be reset to the shore checkpoint instead of the one closest to your location.
[*] Additional proofreading and localisation improvements have been made
[*] A small pot icon has been added under the painting puzzle in the dining room to indicate that the key to the kitchen can be found there.
[/list]
[u][b]Please leave a review if you like the game.[/b][/u]

Have fun!
Crimsonite Team

notes.title: Update 5
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We are happy to announce that we are back with another update, this time with several new features and improvements. So without furder ado, here is the list of changes:
[list]
[*] [u][b]Gordian Rooms 2 is now fully Steam Deck compatible[/b][/u]. 
We made several changes so that it gets the Verified badge.
[*] [u][b]Steam Trading cards, Profile features and additional Steam Community items are here![/b][/u] 
With someone's favourite cabbage as the main focus. :gord2smile: :gord2heart: :gord2cry: :gord2cool: :gord2clown: :gord2angry: :gord2sus: :gord2wow:
[*][u][b]We have made significant changes under the hood and as a result the game should run smoother,[/b][/u] we have seen an increase of 15-25 FPS on average on the Isle of Lye.
[*] [u][b]Thanks to the great efforts of WNM the game's Russian translation has been overhauled![/b][/u]
[*] We also went through the German, French and Hungarian translations so they should see small improvements too, your feedback was also included.
[*] We fine tuned some puzzle descriptions and corrected some typos in the English version as well.
[*] [u][b]Controls have recieved some upgrades too, the gamepad thumbstick controls movement speed much better.[/b][/u] 
Now slower, more intricate movement is possible.
[*] Additionaly there is a Dead zone setting for gamepad users, which changes the sensitivity of the thumbstick. You can use this to fine tune how fast you move and look around.
[*] From now on, the default graphics settings are set to low, to make sure that the game won't run into any problems.  Plus, we disabled head bobbing by default as well.
You can change these settings instantenously from the options menu.
[*] We added a RESET button for the Dining room slider puzzle. 
If you find this one difficult to solve, you can check this video for some clues:
https://youtu.be/1HEAa1vqTVI?feature=shared&t=188
You can decrease the playback speed on Youtube if you find the video too fast.
[/list]

[u][b]Please leave a review if you enjoy the game.[/b][/u]

Have fun!
Crimsonite Team

notes.title: Update 2
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We have made some additional changes to the game based on your feedback.
[list]
[*] Added a Highlight mode, you can activate it by pressing Left-Alt, by default. When you do so all items that you can pick up will be highlighted with a flashing white circle for a couple of seconds. 

[b]Please note that if you have a lot of items that you didn't pick up in a certain area this effect may get overwhelming. The primary use of this feature is for locating items that you didn't find on your first or second inspection of an area. [/b] 
How frequently you make use of this feature is up to your preferences.

[*] We added the option to toggle always displaying the mouse cursor, so you wouldn't need to make an extra click once you are in the menus.
[*] We fixed an issue of not being able to pick up the horseshoe, once you have completed the Mask collection puzzle. Now youi can do so.
[*] Fixed a small issue of an infinite supply of crowbars.
[*] Fixed the issue of the football gate lights not remaining On after scoring a goal.
[*] Fixed some minor graphical issues
[/list]

[u][b]Please leave a review if you enjoy the game.[/b][/u]

We read all your feedback on the forums.

We hope you have fun!
Crimsonite Team

notes.title: Gordian Rooms 2 is available now!
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone![/b]

[u][b]The big day has finally arrived and the gates of the Isle of Lye are finally open to those who dare to challenge the Gordian Society![/b][/u]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/TKVM4Ng.gif[/img]

[u]Here is a quick outline of how we improved the game since Gordian Rooms 1:[/u]
[list]
[*] Instead of 4 rooms, you now have a literal island to explore and complete puzzles on. The whole game is on a completely different level of scope than the first one.
[*] There are a lot of tasks you can complete, and these are clearly defined for you in the game. Collecting horseshoes is back and it is more useful than ever!
[*] You can discover various stories as you explore the island, getting to know the Lye family and their associates. The total amount of story text you can read is enough for a short novella.
[*] As you have a much larger area to explore we introduced free roaming movement, you can also zoom in, crouch and sprint to your heart’s content. We made sure you actually had to use these features to solve some puzzles!
[*] There are several secret areas you may find, though we will not be spoiling anything.
[*] You can sit down and relax in various different locations, to just simply take in the atmosphere and maybe contemplate.
[*] We now have full controller support, this is great if you have difficulties with using a mouse and keyboard or you would like to play on your TV from the comfort of your couch!
[*] You can unlock two different endings based on the number of tokens you acquire, and you may even see a little something extra if you are an avid collector.
[*] You can even play a little football.
[/list]
[b]We made this game with our heart and soul during the past three years [/b]and really really hope that it shows.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40221941/d78130c24996d8a06dd40cf1ca4490c24760ec39.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40221941/6dad80e5b49c3eb1672451ac87c9159f4579220e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40221941/35a49d5cbd588b5228d0eb866e8c1a53e9794aaf.jpg[/img]
[u]As a small thank you for those that have supported us so far, we made a bundle that gives you a small discount on the second game, if you own the first one. [/u]
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/7172/Uncles_Selection/
Thank you for your patience and support!
[u]We hope you will have a great time.[/u]

[u][b]See you on the Isle of Lye![/b][/u]
Adam and Laszlo

notes.title: Demo version 1.3 and Puzzle Fest
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Since our last update we have been steadily working on the game, and we are happy to announce that the development of almost every back-end system has been completed. 

This means that now there is: 
[list]
[*]a working tutorial, to introduce the various mechanisms of the game; the Objectives, Inventory and Journal panels for instance
[*]a new hint system
[*]a redesigned save system
[*]localization support, so you can change between languages
[*]full controller support, now in the menus as well and an alternative control scheme for just keyboards
[/list]
We have also added a couple of community suggestions, for example the ability to toggle the inspection sound or a small target reticule to make it easier to navigate whilst playing.

As we have stated a couple of months earlier, the demo uses the latest lighting technology from Unreal Engine, Lumen. The entire lighting of the rooms has been remade with the advantages and shortcomings of this system in mind. Hopefully, now you should really feel like you are trapped in here during the evening.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40221941/a0c63d52cabd8b8479fe2285d354026f04d9cf18.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40221941/5448d8070a70a4706b8f755ad5a599835d17e753.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40221941/26ea199df993506ebbb7b7c03f8b4926cfa7de6e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40221941/76d28c3e1483a66d990ef71b3f7aa119af630b63.png[/img]

While this part of the development is done, we have still more tasks ahead of us. We have been working on the puzzles on the island and polishing everything to look, feel and sound as nice as we can make it!

When we are closer to completion we will be back with another post.

Thank you!
Crimsonite Team

notes.title: Progress Update 2
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

A common question we hear is: "When will the game be released?” 
We originally predicted that we would be able to release the game in March. 
We've done our best to meet that date, but recently it became clear that we wouldn't be able to finish in time. 

That doesn't mean we haven't made a lot of progress! In Gordian Rooms 2, instead of being trapped in the titular rooms themselves, you will be able to explore a small island with lots of puzzles in and out of sight.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40221941/066f28dab20f143754274bbab50ad8cd23d18330.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40221941/20e304b586ceb5c69f0d3222036863da4cf3350f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40221941/39409cfb6c1fce6b60bafdf32f470a202e8db108.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40221941/d1462156616bcdb458c015f5428389dac2c1ef13.jpg[/img]

Once you have made your way to the island, you will also find a lavish mansion with several rooms, each containing different puzzles:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40221941/3e4f5dd0a60a64cba32ca2866c3b175c5b4c4634.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40221941/529c6d148e481e02c6d2f62fa13de23b4f653148.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40221941/65df38c7865c267d193de534d034acb5780d58fc.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40221941/9d3b09772e6c6de6f6732d3df62f8059e6c17e9c.jpg[/img]

So hopefully it will be worth the wait! We are trying our best to finish the game as soon as possible, but with only 2 developers and only one published project behind us, we lack the experience to predict how long things will take.  

[b]What's the release date then? 
Q2 2023. [/b]

To be more precise would require us to make predictions again, which we have already shown we are not too good at. We will announce the exact date as soon as we know it, most likely a month prior. 

[u]We spent over two years of constant development time on the game and don’t want anything to spoil the experience, so we kindly ask for your patience.[/u]

Thank you and have a nice day!
Crimsonite Team

notes.title: Progress Update
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

We are happy to announce that the game is steadily getting closer to completion. We have just updated the Store page for Gordian Rooms 2 and published some of the first screenshots from the Island, where the game takes place. 

You can check them out below, and we have decided to share our closest estimate with regards to the possible release of the game. If all goes according to plan you will be able to play Gordian Rooms 2 sometime in the first quarter of 2023. The Store page should reflect this as well. 

We haven’t forgotten about the demo version either, however we decided to release one more final update to it, which will also be released as a separate game titled “Gordian rooms 2: Prologue”, just like we did with Gordian Rooms 1.

Even if we don’t specifically react to your comments we read all of them and try our best to improve the game based on this feedback.

Have a pleasant day!

[list]
